LanguageData.CC_Base_Sub: What stands where it shouldn't, what leads nowhere, and what a click can put right.
LanguageData.CC_Base_HeaderTip: Once an hour the council walks the base: rooms that belong together far apart and rooms that belong apart close together, long walks to meals, doors that separate nothing, stubs of wall, conduits and pipes that lead nowhere, a freezer door that opens into the warm. What matters most comes first. The findings are also proposed on the Plan page.
LanguageData.CC_Base_AllGood: Nothing to put right. The base is in order, as far as the council can see.
LanguageData.CC_Base_FixTip: Gives deconstruct orders for {0} thing(s). Cancel them on the map like any other order.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Far_kitchenfreezer: {D} cells to the nearest {B}: the cook walks that way and back for the makings of every meal. A freezer with a door into the kitchen saves hours a season.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Far_kitchendining: {D} cells to the nearest {B}: every meal is carried that far, and the table is where people see the cook's work. Side by side, the kitchen hands straight through.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Far_diningrec: {D} cells to the nearest {B}: people rest right after they eat, and walk that far to do it. Next door, they drift from the table to the games.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Far_workshopstore: {D} cells to the nearest {B}: every bill starts with a walk for materials and ends with one to put the work away. A store room beside the workshop, or shelves in it, keeps the hands at the bench.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Far_hospitalgate: {D} cells from the {B}: the wounded are carried that far across the base after a fight. A hospital near the way in is reached first.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Far_barnfields: {D} cells from the nearest {B}: the hay and the animals cross the base each day. A barn by the fields keeps the mud outside.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Close_bedroomworkshop: {N} bedroom(s) share a wall with the {B} or near enough: benches run early and late, and light sleepers wake. Bedrooms away from the noise sleep better.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Close_bedroombarn: {N} bedroom(s) right by the {B}: the animals are loud at night and the smell comes through the door. Bedrooms away from the barn sleep better.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Close_hospitalworkshop: The hospital lies right by the {B}: the sick rest badly beside the benches, and the dust comes in. Quiet heals.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Close_prisonbedroom: {N} cell(s) right by the colonists' bedrooms: a breakout starts beside sleeping people. Cells apart from the bedrooms, near the gate, are safer.
LanguageData.CC_Base_MealWalk_Detail: The {N} bedroom(s) lie {D} cells from the nearest dining room on average: three walks a day each, there and back. Bedrooms around the dining room, or a second dining room among the far ones, give the hours back.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Doors_Detail: Both sides of the door are the same room, or there is no wall beside it. Left from a wall that came down, it only slows people on their way. Take it down and the materials come back.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Stubs_Detail: Short runs of wall that separate nothing, hanging off a proper wall: left from rebuilding. Walls with a lamp on them or holding up a roof on their own are not counted.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Conduits_Detail: Runs of conduit from a fork or a used piece out to an end with nothing on it. Every conduit can short out and start a fire; the ones that feed nothing only add to that. Take them down and the steel comes back.
LanguageData.CC_Base_OrphanConduits_Detail: A stretch of conduit with no generator, battery or user on it at all: left from something moved. Take it down and the steel comes back.
LanguageData.CC_Base_Pipes_Detail: Runs of pipe from a fork or a fixture out to an end with nothing on it. Take them down and the materials come back.
LanguageData.CC_Base_FreezerDoor: The freezer's door opens into the {B}
LanguageData.CC_Base_FreezerDoor_Detail: {T} °C inside, {TB} °C beyond the door: warm air comes in with every opening and the coolers work to push it out. A second door with a cell between, an airlock, keeps the cold where it belongs.
